name: technova-ecommerce-lab
description: Lab de E-commerce para Testes QA - Padrão Ouro de Automação

scripts.setup:
npm install && npm install --prefix backend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const envContent='DB_USER=admin
DB_PASSWORD=technovapass
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=5432
DB_DATABASE=technova_db
PORT=5000'; fs.writeFileSync('.env', envContent); fs.writeFileSync(path.join('backend', '.env'), envContent);" && rm -rf cypress/e2e/1-getting-started cypress/e2e/2-advanced-examples && echo '✅ AMBIENTE BLINDADO: .env gerado na raiz e no backend!'
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && (npm run backend & npm run frontend)

author: André Gonçalves
